title: Collecting the Premium on a Plan of the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans
content:
The premium on a plan of the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans is collected on the schedule the coverage sets: in one payment at the till, or monthly for as long as coverage runs. A monthly premium is late once the coverage's premium grace in calendar days has passed, and coverage is suspended once the unpaid premium reaches the coverage's suspension threshold in days. A premium payment is received against a plan only while that plan stands at quoted, active, inspection overdue or suspended. Clearing the arrears lifts a suspension from the day they are cleared, and the months coverage was suspended are not answered for after the fact. Where coverage is included with the piece no premium is collected at all, and nothing about the premium schedule applies to it.

## Standings at which a premium is received

| Standing of the plan | A premium payment is received against it |
|---|---|
| quoted | yes |
| active | yes |
| inspection overdue | yes |
| suspended | yes |
| exhausted, expired, cancelled, transferred | no |

The standing is read from the plan record before the payment is taken.

## The two schedules side by side

| | Premium collected in one payment | Premium collected monthly |
|---|---|---|
| When lateness arises | the premium is taken once at the till | a premium is late once the coverage's grace in calendar days has passed |
| How coverage comes to be suspended for money | not on this schedule | once the unpaid premium reaches the coverage's threshold in days |
| Effect of clearing what is owed | not on this schedule | the suspension is lifted from the day the arrears are cleared, and the suspended months are not answered for afterwards |
